source_behavior.role: Period validation; existing non-cancelled run returns; employees_manage; selects monthly CreatedAtUtc ledger entries; computes and freezes lines; handles period unique insert conflict.
Validates PayrollRules transition; employees_manage plus payroll_approve for Approved; writes state/metadata only, separate from payout.
Approved permits Paid or Cancelled; Paid/Cancelled terminal. Calculator matches canonical PascalCase ledger type names and builds net lines.

Requires approved run/payroll_pay/open day/positive total; transaction + locked treasury account balance + journal key per run; one treasury movement and one settlement debit per positive line; marks Paid; replays same-run receipt.
Case-insensitive enum parse is canonicalized before persistence, counterevidence supporting lowercase bonus scenario.
Daily wage/overtime endpoints post canonical DailyWage/Overtime credit entries; overtime requires positive hours and computes configured/custom rate.

coverage_gaps: No monthly salary, inactive employee, multiemployee, deduction/advance, correction, negative or cross-month case.
No Cancelled transition, Paid generic-transition behavior, or pay/cancel race. Lifecycle-named test stops at Approved.
Payout test uses one employee; no multi-line conservation, distinct-run source-account contention, changed-payload retry, atomic-failure case, or standalone employee-settlement overlap.
Concurrency expectations are test-source assertions only and were not executed against any provider.

cross_references.conclusion: No pay/cancel overlap test: all payout fixtures leave run Approved until pay; lifecycle test stops at Approved.
No test sends generic transition target Paid; does not establish whether generic transition alone can pay.
No standalone PayEmployeeHandler/Settlement flow; does not resolve overlap policy or combined sequence.
Manual entry handler stores canonical enum spelling; PayrollRules reads canonical Bonus, matching tested setup.
